The first kind of body wave is the P wave or primary wave. This is the fastest kind of seismic wave, and, consequently, the first to 'arrive' at a seismic station. There are P wave detectors that will shut off gas or shut down other sensitive equipment. You might get 10-30 seconds advance warning unless you're right on top of the epicenter.
